parts.intro: A proper rebuild specification identifies the actual components and work. We use OEM or appropriate OE-quality parts matched to the engine and agreed scope.
checklist: Bearings, rings, timing and sealing work as appropriate.
Ancillaries (turbo, injector, fuel pump) are assessed separately.
Any additional damage and extra work is explained in advance.
details: The condition of the block, crankshaft, head and reusable internals informs the decision; rebuilding does not mean every surrounding component is automatically new.
The purpose is an engine repair based on compatibility, condition and the diagnosed cause, not a cosmetic refresh or an unsupported promise of better-than-factory performance.
fullText: A proper rebuild specification identifies the actual components and work. We use OEM or appropriate OE-quality parts matched to the engine and agreed scope. The condition of the block, crankshaft, head and reusable internals informs the decision; rebuilding does not mean every surrounding component is automatically new.

Bearings, rings, timing and sealing work are specified as appropriate. A turbocharger, injector, fuel pump or other ancillary has its own condition and inclusion decision. Where significant additional damage changes the repair, the scope is explained before extra work proceeds.
The purpose is an engine repair based on compatibility, condition and the diagnosed cause, not a cosmetic refresh or an unsupported promise of better-than-factory performance.

repairOrRebuild.intro: A contained repair may be sufficient when the engine's internals remain sound. A recoverable core with confirmed wear or damage may justify a rebuild. The rest of the vehicle and your plans for it also matter.
details: Major block, crankshaft or head damage, unavailable parts or extensive connected-system repairs can change the economics. We discuss the evidence and scope so you can consider the work rather than assuming every fault needs a whole-engine overhaul.

A cheaper advertised engine unit is not the same service as diagnosing, repairing and refitting your vehicle's engine. If you are searching for a replacement engine, start by telling us what happened to the original unit. This homepage offers an assessment and rebuilding service, not a catalogue of new or used engines for purchase.
